narrative.details: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting $2oa Free Action Potion, along with information about delivery location and payment.  At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
narrative.objectives: Acquire the items requested by the customer and deliver them to the location marked on your map. This writ must be in your possession to complete the transaction.
narrative.offerRewardText: <You waste little time offering the wiggling mass the Free Action Potion that was requested. It seems either unaware of your presence, or unable to claim the item.A handful of coins are scattered just beside the cocoon. You may decide to leave the potion there, and take the coins for yourself. Nature will surely sort itself out, in that case.>
narrative.requestItemsText: <You approach a thrashing creature clearly trapped in spider silk, exactly where the writ marked on the map.>

giverName: an item: Craftsman's Writ: Free Action Potion
